descriptionFull: The Eurasian treecreeper or common treecreeper ( Certhia familiaris ) is a small passerine bird also known in the British Isles, where it is the only living member of its genus, simply as treecreeper . It is similar to other treecreepers, and has a curved bill, patterned brown upperparts, whitish underparts, and long stiff tail feathers which help it creep up tree trunks.
